% Hand-authored (NOT generated by scripts/generate_tikz_figures.py -- that
% script only produces the data-driven figures elsewhere in figures/tikz/).
% Self-contained: no .dat files, no pgfplots. Unfolds the "frontier
% predictor" box of fig_fanta_architecture into its 2 pre-norm sublayers
% (manta/model.py: FrontierLayer, SlidingWindowAttention, FrontierPredictor).
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=4mm and 4mm,
  box/.style={draw, rounded corners, align=center, minimum height=7mm,
    minimum width=52mm, font=\footnotesize, inner sep=3pt, fill=gray!5},
  small/.style={draw, rounded corners, align=center, minimum height=6mm,
    minimum width=30mm, font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2pt, fill=white},
  hl/.style={draw=oursCol, line width=0.8pt},
  plus/.style={draw, circle, minimum size=4.5mm, inner sep=0pt, font=\small},
  arr/.style={-{Latex[length=1.6mm]}, thick},
  skip/.style={-{Latex[length=1.4mm]}, thin, gray!45},
  skiplbl/.style={font=\scriptsize, gray!70},
]

% -- input: byte embedding + positional encoding --
\node[box] (embed) {byte embedding $e_i$, dim 64};
\node[plus, below=6mm of embed] (plus0) {$+$};
\node[small, right=12mm of plus0] (posenc) {sinusoidal\\pos.\ encoding};
\draw[arr] (embed) -- (plus0);
\draw[arr] (posenc) -- (plus0);

% -- pre-norm sublayer 1: LayerNorm + sliding-window attention (one box) --
\node[box, below=6mm of plus0, minimum height=13mm] (attn)
  {LayerNorm $\to$ sliding-window attention\\bidirectional, $|i-j|\le w{=}8$, 4 heads, dim 64};
\node[plus, below=6mm of attn] (plus1) {$+$};
\draw[arr] (plus0) -- (attn);
\draw[arr] (attn) -- (plus1);

% -- pre-norm sublayer 2: LayerNorm + feed-forward (one box) --
\node[box, below=6mm of plus1, minimum height=11mm] (ffn)
  {LayerNorm $\to$ feed-forward\\Linear(64$\to$256), GELU, Linear(256$\to$64)};
\node[plus, below=6mm of ffn] (plus2) {$+$};
\draw[arr] (plus1) -- (ffn);
\draw[arr] (ffn) -- (plus2);

% -- residual connections: drawn as labeled arcs bulging to the right,
% each carrying the pre-sublayer state around its LayerNorm+sublayer box
% and back in at the following "+" (same x' = x + Sublayer(LayerNorm(x))
% pre-norm rule as the footnote in the main text). --
\draw[skip] (plus0.east) to[out=0, in=0, looseness=1.6]
  node[skiplbl, pos=0.5, xshift=2mm] {$x$} (plus1.east);
\draw[skip] (plus1.east) to[out=0, in=0, looseness=1.6]
  node[skiplbl, pos=0.5, xshift=2mm] {$x'$} (plus2.east);

% -- "x2" loop annotation around the repeated pre-norm block --
\begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
\node[draw, dashed, rounded corners, inner sep=3mm,
  fit=(attn)(plus1)(ffn)(plus2)] (loopbox) {};
\end{pgfonlayer}
\node[font=\footnotesize, anchor=south west] at (loopbox.north west) {$\times 2$};

% -- output: linear head + sigmoid (one box) --
\node[box, below=6mm of plus2, minimum height=9mm] (headsig)
  {linear head (dim $64\to1$) + sigmoid};
\node[box, hl, below=6mm of headsig] (out)
  {frontier probability $p_i=\sigma(\text{logit}_i)$};
\draw[arr] (plus2) -- (headsig);
\draw[arr] (headsig) -- (out);

\end{tikzpicture}
